scope.summary: Expose vector primitives in a form the 14.13 interchange layer can serialize/round-trip through SVG (primary open vector interchange), PDF, and source-suite vector formats — preserving anchors, handles, fill rules, corner specs, appearance stacks where the target format allows and degrading predictably where it does not — WITHOUT a private shadow model. Import/export fidelity + lossy-mapping rules are owned by 14.13; this MT guarantees the vector domain surfaces its primitives for interop.
acceptance_criteria: vector primitives exposed for 14.13 SVG/PDF round-trip with predictable degradation; no shadow model
expected_tests: test: anchors/handles/fill-rules/corner-specs/appearance survive SVG round-trip via the exposed surface; predictable degradation; no private shadow model

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Vector geometry not interop-serializable; SVG/PDF round-trip loses data.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
